This topic is part of the IB HL IBDP Computer Science specification.

Computer Organisation appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Computer Organisation in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The IB HL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Computer Organisation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
